notes.title: 🩸 Under The Floor – Patch Notes 0.2.75 🩸
notes.notes: [p][b]Get ready to shiver… This update introduces new paranormal events, gameplay improvements, and numerous fixes to make the horror experience even more intense.[/b][/p][h3]🔔 New Features & Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Haunting statue[/b]: it now emits a sound whenever it moves—keep your eyes open and your ears sharper.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic footsteps[/b]: footstep sounds now change when the player walks on concrete for deeper immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Brighter atmosphere[/b]: overall brightness has been slightly increased while maintaining the oppressive mood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Look further down[/b]: the player can now tilt the camera lower to inspect every dark corner.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Two new paranormal events[/b]: unexpected supernatural occurrences will keep you on edge.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚠️ Gameplay Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p][b]Unpredictable hunts[/b]: both the waiting time [i]and[/i] the duration of hunts are now randomized.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Limited interactions[/b]: equipment can no longer be used while interacting with an in-game object.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved flashlight[/b]: it now recharges faster during the day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Ouija board[/b]: completely reworked to better understand the player’s questions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🕯️ Additional Content[/h3][list][*][p]A [b]new warning message[/b] now informs players that sleeping will no longer be possible after a certain day…[/p][/*][*][p][b]New objective[/b]: complete a special task to obtain the [b]Whispering Key[/b], which unlocks the mysterious basement door.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Lamps during hunts[/b]: fixed an issue where some lamps remained on during a hunt.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exterior environment clipping[/b]: resolved a clipping issue in outdoor scenery.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ending scene audio[/b]: fixed a sound issue during the final scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Translation errors[/b]: several translation mistakes have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death scene audio[/b]: fixed an audio bug in the death scene.[/p][/*][/list][p]…and many more secrets waiting to be discovered 👀[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Version 0.2.73.4
notes.notes: [h3]✨ Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Damage visuals[/b]: Improved hit and damage effects for better readability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Battery display and [b]battery recharge status[/b] are now smoother.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stamina display[/b] is now more fluid for a more natural feel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]floating icon for letters[/b] to make them easier to spot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay[/b]: Increased the [b]base repair speed for cameras[/b], making the action faster and more dynamic.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Fixes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Twitch integration[/b]: Fixed an issue where Twitch commands could randomly stop working.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam achievements[/b]: Achievements already unlocked will no longer attempt to unlock again.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Report menu[/b]: Fixed an [b]incorrect translation[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alarm system[/b]: It is no longer possible to enter an [b]infinite number of digits[/b] on the keypad.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔧 Support tools[/h3][list][*][p]When sending a [b]report[/b], the player's [b]logs[/b] are now automatically attached to help with debugging and future fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Under The Floor – Patch Notes v0.2.73
notes.notes: [h2]📝 Patch Notes – Version 0.2.73[/h2][h3]✨ New Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Cameras can now break and be repaired[/b], adding a new strategic layer to surveillance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Orbs are visible on cameras[/b], allowing you to track the entity’s position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New AI spawn method[/b]: the entity now spawns on the orbs, making it completely unpredictable.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🌐 Languages[/h3][list][*][p][b]Pre-integration of Italian and Spanish[/b], coming soon in the language options.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed [b]various bugs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved overall stability[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam integration: [b]achievements now unlock correctly[/b] again.[/p][/*][/list]
